title: Photochemically-made gold nanorods for adsorption and SERS detection of cocaine and benzoylecgonine in latent fingerprints
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44164-44172
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04284D, Paper

Detection of illegal drugs in fingermarks is a routine activity of the scientific police and it can be better carried out with SERS spectroscopy using gold nanorods.
